Gold_Standard_clean_text: Assume AD and let G ⊆ 𝕄_{ℵ_1 ℵ_2} be V-generic. Then ℵ_{ω+1} is regular in V[G].
Suppose that ℵ_0 < κ < λ and both κ and λ are measurable. Then Gal(𝒰,λ,λ) holds whenever 𝒰 is a normal ultrafilter over κ.
Let V be a model of AD and let G ⊆ 𝕄_{ℵ_1 ℵ_2} be V-generic. Then ℵ_1 is measurable in V[G] and 𝒟_{ℵ_1} is an ultrafilter.
(a) If κ = cf(λ) then C(λ,κ) ↛ C(λ,κ). (b) If Gal(𝒟_κ,λ,λ) holds then C(λ,κ) → C(λ,κ). (c) If κ = cf(λ) then ¬Gal(𝒟_κ,λ,λ).
Assume GCH. One can force 𝔤𝔭 = λ whenever λ > cf(λ) = ω_1. Moreover, this statement has no consistency strength.
